notes.title: DON'T! FRET - WE ARE MAKING GREAT PROGRESS!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Community,[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910425/f03ab15b487a0ad8b826560971bb7c88b0d7654d.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

It’s been a little while since our last official Steam Hub post, so thank you for your patience and continued interest in Don't! Fret. If you haven't already, be sure to join our Discord for more frequent updates and behind-the-scenes content:
👉 https://discord.gg/vHkv6HQztB

We recently released a detailed devlog video with tons of new info on development progress. You can check it out here:
[previewyoutube=t_DtsFYVzhQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1]UPDATES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910425/d11786e1dddcf18c037776fa22617948cb7405f2.png[/img]
We’re actively playtesting the first third of Don't! Fret!
All core gameplay mechanics are now complete.
Our main enemy, Tapehead, has undergone a major overhaul — and Fret has received some updates too.
We’ve created a brand-new, redesigned capsule art that better represents the game’s vibe and characters. Can’t wait to share it with you soon!
The current playtime for the first third of the game is averaging 1.5 hours, which means you can expect the full game to be around 4–5 hours long.
We've decided to make all cutscenes in-engine, resulting in a more seamless and immersive experience.
[h1]GAMEPLAY UPDATES[/h1]

You may have seen this mentioned on other platforms, but for those who haven't: the demo was just a tiny peek at Don't! Fret's atmosphere and tone — the final game is significantly more robust and polished in terms of gameplay.

Our original inspiration was to capture the intense, cat-and-mouse style of Alien: Isolation. And while we're a small team with limited resources, I truly believe we've built something that captures that same kind of tension.

The gameplay now blends elements of Resident Evil, Silent Hill, and Alien: Isolation.
The demo’s AI was very basic — “run-at-the-player” style — but that's completely changed. We’re spending a ton of time refining enemy behavior and making every encounter feel fun, tense, and rewarding.

[h1]VARIETY[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910425/7b101727ea3fdb7fb8581b9542827ebb15477274.png[/img]

One of the things I’m most proud of is the variety in Don't! Fret.

Yes, the game is set in a school — but trust me when I say, it’s a wild ride of constantly evolving environments and surprising set pieces. We’re working hard to make sure each area feels distinct and keeps you on your toes.

When I say varied, I really mean it.

[h1]RELEASE DATE[/h1]

We’ve made the decision to move our release window to early 2026.

This gives us the time we need to avoid crunch, polish the experience, and make sure Don't! Fret is the best it can possibly be when it reaches you.

[h1]THANK YOU[/h1]

Thank you all so much for your continued support. It means the world to our team.

If you haven’t already, come hang out with us on Discord — we’d love to chat and keep you in the loop as we get closer to release!

See you soon,
💀 Scary Kid Studios

notes.title: DON'T! FRET END OF YEAR UPDATE!
notes.content:
[h1]2024 WAS AN AMAZING YEAR[/h1]
We kicked off the year back in March with the announcement trailer for Don't! Fret, which in the first month received over 200K views. The hype was very real, and it was amazing to begin to put Don't! Fret on the map. In case you didn't know, Scary Kid Studios has a YouTube channel where put Devlogs, Trailers and more!

[previewyoutube=BwslxiWXHUM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1]DEMO RELEASE[/h1]
On October 18th, we released the demo for Don't! Fret: The Audition. For those of you who follow our other socials you will know, that this demo actually was intended to be an entire Chapter 1 (when we had it as an episodic format!). After much debate, we decided to turn Don't! Fret into a full length came, and we are aiming for a 4-7 hour game experience! 

The demo was received incredibly well, and we currently have 97 reviews with a VERY POSITIVE rating! We also had so many incredible influencers play the demo, including our very own Game Theory! 

[previewyoutube=y6hX0qViqLs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1]WHAT'S NEXT?[/h1]
We have been VERY quiet since the release of the Don't! Fret demo and the reason is a good one... WE ARE VERY HARD AT WORK ON THE FULLY GAME ːsteamhappyː

As game developers, this is our first game and so there are so many things and processes we are learning as we go. It took us over a year just to get the demo into a solid, playable state with art assets, mechanics, sound design etc. Since the demo, we have hired on a new full time developer, and additional help with animations and 3D modeling. The game is turning into a beast we could have never imaged possible (in a good way)!

We have overhauled many of the mechanics that were in the demo. Doors, portals, equipment, enemies and so much more. The demo was only scratching the surface of the story we are diving into in the full game!

[h1]WHEN IS THE RELEASE?[/h1]
In an effort to be transparent, as we always try and do - we don't have an official release date for the game however, we are aiming for Q3 or Q4 of 2025. So far, we have been doing a great job sticking to our schedules and milestone reviews. 

As the game grows, and we begin to fully test - I'm sure we can expect some roadblocks, but rest assured - we are planning for them!

Thank you to everyone who has continued to support us along this crazy journey. Looking forward to seeing you in the new year! We're cooking up some amazing things and we can't wait to show you!

notes.title: PATCH 1.1 - Performance Optimization & Xbox Controller Support
notes.content:
[b]CPU & GPU Performance Optimization[/b]
50% frame increase
Significantly reduced draw calls
Reduced total triangles visible on screen
LOD optimization
Batched static mesh throughout the map
GPU optimization with particle effects

[b]Xbox Controller Support[/b]
Xbox controller support
NOTE: There are known issues with keypad losing movement with controller. If this happens, you can use your mouse and keyboard to progress
NOTE: PS5 and Steam Deck support is not fully compatible yet but is on the horizon

[b]Added additional frame limits[/b]
Increased frame limit cap to 144

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Player can no longer interact with light switch from inside of Waste Room
Pressing wrong number on payphone no longer results in an infinite dial
Player can no longer move during cut scenes after first playthrough
Fixed issue where player can press reload on flashlight and begin to use it before animation is completed
Fixed issue where interacting with machine or cassette player would allow you to use an item without being near it

[b]Known Issues[/b]
Xbox controller input issues where controller loses input for certain objects like keypad, payphone
No PS4 or PS5 controller support
No Steam Deck Support

notes.title: Don't! Fret Demo Launch
notes.content:
WE HIT 3,500 downloads of Don't! Fret: The Audition over the launch weekend! This is an incredible milestone, and we are so thrilled of the response from the community.

62 of you also left reviews, which REALLY helps our visibility out! 

While this is amazing, and we are excited - we also have a lot of work ahead of us!

[h2][b]PATCH UPDATE 1.1[/b][/h2]

We are already working on a 1.1 patch for many of the bugs / feedback that was submitted over the weekend! Thank you all for taking the time to show videos and give descriptions of how some of these occured - it really helps us out!

We will be working on optimization, bugs AND controller support!

We are aiming to release 1.1 by next Tuesday 10/29 so, stay tuned!

[h2][b]WHAT'S AHEAD[/b][/h2]

We have some really fun plans ahead as well to make sure the demo is an evolving game over the roadmap leading up to the game's full release, so keep an eye out!

[h2][b]SECRETS & EASTER EGGS[/b][/h2]

We including a LOT of secrets and easter eggs in Don't! Fret and so far we are realizing that many of you haven't found them yet! Keep playing, exploring and enjoying Don't! Fret.

[h2][b]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/b][/h2]

https://discord.gg/vHkv6HQztB

notes.title: DON'T! FRET: THE AUDITION RELEASE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910425/398bef1007567925c193af0203e7014146f2e4d9.png[/img]

[b][h3][b]DON'T! FRET IS FINALLY HERE[/b][/h3][/b]
We are so excited to announce the release date of the demo of Don't! Fret. We have been working so hard on this experience, and we can't wait to share it with the world! A few things to note as we prepare for the demo!

[b][h3][h2]CONTENT CREATOR FIRST LOOK KEYS[/h2][/h3][/b]
If you are a content creator, and would like a key to play Don't! Fret early, please use this [url=https://forms.gle/QeWeD5vtdFSc9zmj6]Google Form [/url]to be considered. We will be sending personalized keys out on Monday 10/14/24. NOTE: We won't be able to send keys to everyone, so if you aren't chosen - it doesn't mean we don't love you!

[b][h3]WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE DEMO?[/h3][/b]
We had many conversations internally of how we wanted to present the demo to the world. Don't! Fret was originally going to be an episodic game, with chapters releasing periodically as we completed the game.Instead we have decided to create a full length game, which means - we wanted community feedback. That's where the demo comes in!

Don't! Fret: The Audition is a full experience, and will tie into the main game. Consider it a prologue, and a standalone product. 

[h3][b]WE NEED YOUR HELP[/b][/h3]
I've been a content creator and music producer with Rockit Music for over 10 years... but developing a game is something I have NEVER done! 

Our team is comprised of 13 individuals, and we all work remotely, and this is ALL of our first game. It has become an incredibly huge undertaking that none of us fully expected, nor set out to do in the first place.
I genuinely ask the community, and everyone who plays to leave feedback for us to help us improve mechanics or issues that arise, to ensure we create the best possible product for the full game release.

Thank you all from the bottom of our hearts. We hope you enjoy the game.

- Scary Kid Studios

notes.title: DON'T! FRET UPDATES V3
notes.content:
Hey Fretters (we thought this was fun... please tell us if it's not ːsteamsadː)

[h3]WHAT HAVE WE BEEN DOING?[/h3]
Since the launch of the announcement trailer, Don't! Fret has amassed 3K+ wishlists! Thank each and every one of you who has shown interest in our game. 

When the trailer was launched, we had enough of the systems in place to know how the game would play, the core style and design of the world was feeling great, the major plat characters were decided on, and the storyline had a start and an end. There's a whole lot that goes on in between all of those major beats...


[h3]CHAPTER BASED?[/h3]

Don't! Fret was originally going to be a chapter based game, and was going to be about an hour and change with its first installment. The mascot horror trend typically has fallen in this pattern and while there are arguments on both sides to what is the better release schedule, we have felt that the game and it's story will best be consumed as a singular product. 

With this decision, we also felt that it was important that our fans get a taste of what it is we have been cooking up for the past year.... 


[h3]DEMO![/h3]
Steam's Fall Next Fest is approaching and with us wanting to players to get their hands on Don't! Fret - we have decided to work toward getting a demo of Don't! Fret polished and ready for the festival. While there will be many systems in place that aren't fully finished, we are trying to include as many as we can and for those pieces that aren't fully baked out - we will have some really fun concepts for you to enjoy to understand what will be working toward.

My intention with the demo is that you walk away getting a very good sense of the world we are building, have tons of story driven content to feast on, enjoy some scary moments, and ultimately get excited knowing we are working on a video game with the utmost care. I'll stop rambling now...

[h3]NEW GAMEPLAY TRAILER[/h3]
With an upcoming demo we will of course be dropping a new trailer with gameplay for everyone to enjoy hopefully VERY soon!

[h3]VOICE ACTORS[/h3] 
Don't! Fret is a Nerdcore community driven game made by a Nerdcore artist! Me - Rockit from Rockit Music. I am working hard to bring on as many talented Nerdcore artists to be a part of this game on the VA side and I wanted to share with you who is currently a part of the project!

The Stupendium
Longest Solo Ever
OR3O
Jake Neutron 
Cami-Cat 
Mix Williams
Rockit 

I am hoping there will be a lot more when everything is all complete! 

[h3]THANK YOU![/h3]
Thank you again to everyone working on this project and those of you who are supporting us and following our journey! Looking forward to sharing more in the coming weeks!

notes.title: THANK YOU!: WISHLIST MILESTONES & UPDATES!
notes.content:
Hey Fretters! (yes, this you!)

In an effort to be transparent, we will be releasing updates regularly via the community page! We know there is a LOT of ways to ingest content & updates these days, so we will do our best to bundle up everything via 'X', YouTube, Discord, TikTok & Instagram into a single place - HERE ON STEAM COMMUNITY!

Since we first released the announcement trailer just over 3 weeks ago, we have:

1. Hit 2K wishlists on Steam!!!! (Thank you)
2. Have over 150K views on the announcement trailer on YouTube!
3. Released Devlog 1, breaking down the trailer from Rockit of Rockit Music

Because the story behind Don't! Fret is so important to us, and the community - we are going to be doing something we think will be fun for everyone. We will be releasing special teaser trailers to help build the storyline behind Dont'! Fret before you ever step foot inside of the game! 

This will be a way for us to share important info on the story, while we work hard to continue developing the game!

Here is our Devlog 1 for those of you who may have missed it! Stay tuned for this Friday to watch the new trailer!
